builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: Frostbolt from range, with ice to slow enemies and Ice Barrier at level 40 to soak hits. A few Arcane talents at the end save mana.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Stamina and Spirit. Use a staff or a wand, and cloth armor.

why.Improved Frostbolt: Frostbolt, your main spell, takes less time to cast.
why.Frostbite: Your chilling effects sometimes freeze the enemy in place.
why.Ice Shards: Your Frost spells hit harder when they critically strike.
why.Frost Channeling: Frost spells cost less mana, so you can cast more before you drink.
why.Frost Warding: Your Frost Armor protects you more, and so will Ice Barrier when you learn it.
why.Ice Lance: An extra Frost hit to use while an enemy is chilled.
why.Ice Block: A button that makes you safe for a short time when a fight goes badly.
why.Cold Snap: Makes your other Frost spells ready again, and it opens Ice Barrier.
why.Permafrost: Chill effects last longer and slow enemies more, so they reach you later.
why.Improved Frost Nova: Frost Nova is ready again sooner, so you can freeze enemies in place more often.
why.Arctic Reach: Your Frostbolt reaches a little further, so you start fights from safer ground.
why.Ice Barrier: A shield you cast on yourself that soaks up damage, from level 40.
why.Wand Specialization: Your wand does more damage, which helps to finish enemies for free.
why.Arcane Resilience: Gives you more Armor, based on your Intellect.
why.Arcane Concentration: Your spells can make your next spell cost less mana.
why.Shatter: Your spells crit more often against a frozen enemy.
why.Fingers of Frost: Your chill effects sometimes treat the next two spells as hitting a frozen enemy.
why.Improved Cone of Cold: Cone of Cold, an area blast in front of you, hits harder.
why.Magic Absorption: Gives you a little protection against spells, and some mana back.

fight: Start with Frostbolt from far away. Keep casting it until the enemy is dead.
Enemy at your feet? Frost Nova freezes it. Back away before you cast, as damage can break the freeze.
Fire Blast is a quick extra hit. Use it to finish an enemy that is nearly dead.
Ice Lance hits much harder on a frozen enemy. Cast it right after Frost Nova.
Cast Ice Barrier on yourself before a hard fight.
Out of mana? Sit down and drink water. Conjure Water makes more.
Losing a fight? Use Ice Block to be safe, then recover and try again.
